description: This file implements a core component object for a Byte Array system in C, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions. It defines the behavior of an 'AnscByteArray' component, including memory management and method bindings.

classes.name: ANSC_BYTE_ARRAY_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object structure representing a byte array component, including function pointers for operations and internal state.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscByteArrayCOCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new byte array component object, initializes core members and sets up function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscByteArrayCORemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the byte array component object, freeing allocated memory if not a foreign buffer.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscByteArrayCOEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls subordinate objects needed by the byte array component.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscByteArrayCOInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the byte array component object, setting default values and function bindings.
